sentences.en: Please give me something to eat. I am so hungry.
sentences.zh: 请给我点吃的。我饿坏了。

sentences.en: At a glance, he knew that the child was hungry.
sentences.zh: 他一眼就看出那个孩子饿了。

sentences.en: When a dog is very hungry, it devours its food.
sentences.zh: 当狗非常饿的时候，它会狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

senses.zh: 饥饿的,渴望的，渴望得到,（统称）饥民,荒年的，不毛的
